summary: The visible suite now passes (3/3). I changed two files under `solution/`. The main cause was in `solution/util.py`: the operator alternation in `_TOKEN` tried the single-character `*` before `**`, so every `**` was tokenized as two `*` tokens. That made `0**0` and `2*3**2` fail with "unexpected token '*'", and it is why `-2**2` also failed. I reordered the alternation so `\*\*` is matched first. In `solution/core.py`, `power()` parsed its right-hand side with `atom()`, which rejected unary signs even though the grammar comment says they are allowed; I changed it to `unary()` so `2**-1` evaluates to 0.5. I didn't touch `tests/` or add any files. The public `evaluate` API is unchanged, and I spot-checked `2**3**2` (right-associative, 512), `10-4-3`, and `1 - -2` to confirm the rest of the grammar still behaves.
